why: 'a Balatonra megyünk' is the natural answer for the lake/holiday region; -hoz is only 'to the shore'. Wrong options -nál (where) and -ról (from) stay, each one fault, ds entries unchanged.
tó - tavak (ó becomes a, plus v) is not the same change as ló - lovak (only v added), so 'like ló' misleads.
